messages.author: 8d50e41b60472532
messages.subject: Multi-trait analysis
parts:
Hi, I am trying to do multi-trait multi-QTL mapping to help me test for pleiotropy and got a recommendation to use the MTMIM tool implemented in QTL Cartographer (Costa E Silva LD, Wang S, Zeng Z-B. 2012. Multiple trait multiple interval mapping of quantitative trait loci from inbred line crosses. BMC Genet. 13(1):67. https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2156-13-67)

Does a similar multi-trait approach exist in R/qtl, perhaps the mqmscanall function? I can't quite tell from the docs if that function is fitting separate multi-QTL models for all the phenotypes or if the phenotypes are analyzed jointly. Previously I have been fitting one multi-QTL model for each of three traits using stepwiseqtl, and I'm hoping to explicitly consider whether overlapping QTLs for multiple traits that I found in that analysis are likely to be pleiotropic.

Thank you!

Best,
Madison
